verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The closest pair problem is a fundamental problem of computational geometry: given a set of $n$ points in a $d$-dimensional space, find a pair with the smallest distance. verdicts.title: A note on quantum lower bounds for local search via congestion and expansion
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We consider the quantum query complexity of local search as a function of graph geometry.
